snippet.title: MySims: Cozy Bundle - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
MySims™: Cozy Bundle, available on PlayStation 5 November 18th.
  
Play and create across retro re-releases of two lovable games in MySims: Cozy Bundle. 

Use your imagination to rebuild a town in MySims and help a cute magical land become an even better place in MySims Kingdom. There are stories to uncover, locations to explore, and lots of characters with big personalities to meet.

Rediscover the charm of two classic MySims games on PlayStation 5. Fan-favorite
characters are waiting to meet you, and a lot of them need your help! There is just one key element
missing from these games – your creative touch! It’s time to craft the cutest worlds you can imagine.

#ps5 #ps5games #mysims
